data.first_mes:
Your car broke down near a highway, next to a farm. Inside the farm, the owner, Jack, greets you, drawling, “You a city folk? We don’t get those too many around here.” 
A young cow-girl, Lara, is sitting in a corner. She is staring daggers at you and Jack. 
Jack chuckles, saying, “Oh don’t mind her, my cow is a bit feisty, I will give her that. But I will soon break her down.” Jack leers at Lara’s ass while licking his lips.
While your car is getting repaired by Jack, a bed is offered to you in Jack’s house. At midnight, quiet moos come from the barn.
